records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the year ended June 30, 2022 increased 14% to a new record of $1,676 million from the prior-year record total of $1,467 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated sales volumes, measured in pounds shipped, increased 2% in 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Examples of such obligations are commitments to purchase raw materials or packaging inventory that has not yet been received as of June 30, 2022, as well as purchase orders and longer-term purchase arrangements related to the procurement of services, including IT service agreements, and property, plant and equipment.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The inflationary cost environment we experienced during 2022 resulted in significantly higher input costs for our business.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income decreased 40% to $111.9 million in 2022, including the unfavorable impacts of the $25.7 million in restructuring and impairment charges for the Bantam business and the $8.8 million impairment charge for the Angelic tradename intangible asset.
